definitions.explanation: Describes doing something without deliberate awareness or intention. The action happens automatically or out of habit.

examples.japanese: {無意識|むいしき}に{口|くち}ずさんでいた。
examples.english: I was humming without realizing it.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{無意識|むいしき}に{髪|かみ}を{触|さわ}る{癖|くせ}がある。
examples.english: He has a habit of touching his hair without thinking.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}すると{無意識|むいしき}に{足|あし}を{揺|ゆ}らしてしまう。
examples.english: When I get nervous, I involuntarily shake my leg.

notes:
Describes actions performed without the person being aware of doing them. The underlying noun {無意識|むいしき} means 'the unconscious' or 'unconsciousness,' and can also be used as a の-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無意識|むいしき}に{体|からだ}が{動|うご}く: one's body moves involuntarily
- {無意識|むいしき}のうちに: without realizing it
- {無意識|むいしき}に{避|さ}ける: to avoid unconsciously
- {無意識|むいしき}に{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to repeat unconsciously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}わず: involuntarily, unintentionally — emphasizes a spontaneous reaction to a stimulus
- {何気|なにげ}なく: casually, without particular intent — lighter; the person may be vaguely aware but not focused
- {知|し}らず{知|し}らずのうちに: without knowing it — more literary; emphasizes gradual, unnoticed change
